eolis_dyes.name: Ilse's Dyeworks
eolis_dyes.greeting: A cloak says who you are before you do. What color are you today?

eolis_arms.name: Eolis Arms
eolis_arms.greeting: Steel for the roots, wanderer. Pick what keeps you breathing.

eolis_items.name: Eolis Sundries
eolis_items.greeting: Keys, fruit and dew. All honest, mostly.

apolune_armor.name: Apolune Armory
apolune_armor.greeting: Back from the dark, are we? Then you'll want thicker skin.

apolune_items.name: Apolune Provisions
apolune_items.greeting: The sap's gone hard and so have my prices. Mostly.

forepaw_smith.name: Forepaw Forge
forepaw_smith.greeting: Free hands make good steel. Show me that blade of yours, elf.

forepaw_items.name: The Forepaw Larder
forepaw_items.greeting: Dried meat for the climb and a Queen Key for the vaults. The deep galleries kept everything but our appetite.

eolis_charts.name: Maps and Charts
eolis_charts.greeting: Lost already? Every tunnel I have walked is on these, and a few I only heard about.

forepaw_charts.name: Forepaw Survey
forepaw_charts.greeting: Dwarves chart what they dig. Three years in hiding, and I drew every gallery from memory.

conflate_items.name: Conflate Provisions
conflate_items.greeting: Dew and fruit from the high boughs, and ointment the wardens swear by.

conflate_charts.name: Skywatch Charts
conflate_charts.greeting: From the boughs you can see half the Tree. I drew what I saw, and a bit of what the fog let me.

daybreak_armor.name: Stormward Armory
daybreak_armor.greeting: Plate for the sky road. The lightning finds iron, so we forge ours from elf-silver.

daybreak_scrolls.name: The Bell-Tower Scriptorium
daybreak_scrolls.greeting: Every scroll here was copied by lamplight while the storm rang the bells.

daybreak_items.name: Daybreak Stores
daybreak_items.greeting: Dry bread, dry wicks, and ointment for the hail.

daybreak_charts.name: Bell-Ringer's Charts
daybreak_charts.greeting: From the bell loft you can see every isle the wind has not hidden.

victim_keys.name: Odo's Keys and Sundries
victim_keys.greeting: Every lock in the Mist, I have cut a key for. Most of them still turn.

victim_charts.name: Fogwalker's Charts
victim_charts.greeting: I walked the Mist blind for thirty years. Here is what my feet remember.

mascon_scrolls.name: Orla's Scrolls
mascon_scrolls.greeting: Fire, wanderer. It dries the bramble and the damp alike. Few in Mascon can afford to be without it.

mascon_items.name: Brannagh's Stores
mascon_items.greeting: Smoked eel, salve, and keys off the drowned. Don't ask whose.

dartmoor_keys.name: Sigrun's Locks
dartmoor_keys.greeting: Every door in the king's city had its key, and every key passed through my hands. The water kept them bright.
